text:
maya: Heads-up — AcmeHealth sent back their renewal packet with a combined DPA + SOC2 question set. They flagged embeddings retention and BYOK. Can someone help draft answers before EOD?

alex: I can take embeddings retention. Quick note: our default is 90 days for derived embeddings used in feature indexing, unless a customer requests deletion as part of DPA. For embeddings used to improve models we never store customer prompts beyond the configured retention.

maya: sweet — can you write that up as a short paragraph we can paste in the questionnaire? they want a single-line answer in the form + a follow-up doc link.

alex: sure — draft: "Redwood Inference retains customer-generated embeddings for up to 90 days for feature indexing and retrieval. Customers may request earlier deletion via the API or their account rep; deletion requests are tracked and auditable. Embeddings are logically separated per tenant and encrypted at rest using customer-managed keys if BYOK is selected." happy to tweak.

jamal: i'll handle the BYOK / KMS details and the step-by-step for ops. fyi Acme asked if BYOK is available on Dedicated and Private (VPC). quick: Dedicated = yes (customer KMS via integration), Private = yes (customer-managed KMS/HSM supported). Hosted = limited BYOK options (contact sales for a review).

jamie-legal: For the SOC2 questions we should avoid commitments beyond SOC2 scope. Proposed language for SOC2 evidence request: "Redwood Inference maintains SOC2 Type II reports covering common controls; specific evidence requests will be scoped per engagement and may require an NDA or elevating to enterprise support." Also: avoid giving specific retention guarantees for embeddings in SOC2 Qs — funnel to DPA/contract language.

maya: perfect. can we split tasks: alex — paste embeddings paragraph in the form and link to the data-retention doc; jamal — add KMS/BYOK bullets and a short config snippet for Dedicated; jamie-legal — approve final wording before i send?

docbot: New doc created: https://internal.redwood/docs/dpa-answers/acmehealth-1717777777 (view-only) :page_with_curl:

alex: pasted paragraph in the doc + added the API deletion endpoint example:
```
DELETE /v1/customers/{cust_id}/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <token>
```
Will note audit log path for deletion events.

jamal: adding KMS steps: 1) Customer provides key ARN (AWS KMS), 2) We configure key binding in Dedicated pool, 3) Ops confirm rotation windows. sample config: ```{ "kms": { "provider": "aws", "key_arn": "arn:aws:kms:..." } }```

jamie-legal: minor tweak to alex's paragraph — remove phrase "for feature indexing and retrieval" and replace with "for service functionality" to keep it higher level. otherwise LGTM.

alex: updated.

maya: ok final check: i will send answers back to Acme by 3pm PT. jamal — can you join a 30m enablement call tomorrow to walk their infra team through Dedicated BYOK? jamal: yes.

maya: thanks all — i'll paste the final form answers now and tag the customer thread. :thumbsup:

jamal: quick note for renewal risk: Acme flagged stricter residency controls if price goes up — let's have CS propose a pilot Dedicated pool with a fixed term to smooth pricing.

maya: good idea. i'll include a pilot option in the renewal convo.

docbot: Shared doc updated: https://internal.redwood/docs/dpa-answers/acmehealth-1717777777 (updated by alex)

maya: done — sent the completed form. leaving followups in the doc for any customer questions. :rocket:
